title: CPSC, Dynacraft Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Bicycles Sold at Target
summary: The forks on these bicycles can break apart, causing riders to lose control, fall, and suffer serious injury. Units: About 4,700.

title: CPSC, Dollar Tree Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Drip Pans
summary: These drip pans are used under the burners of kitchen ranges to catch food that drips while cooking. The hot burners can ignite the drip pans and pose a fire hazard. Units: About 294,000.

title: CPSC, Snapper, Inc. Recall Lawn Mowers
summary: The walk-behind lawn mowers' side discharge deflector, which is sold as an accessory for these models, is defective. The material used to manufacture the side discharge deflector is not strong enough to prevent projectiles from flying out from under the mower deck, exposing consumers and by-standers

title: CPSC, L.A. Lighter Inc. Announce Recall of Disposable Cigarette Lighters
summary: The lighters may have child-resistant mechanisms that do not meet federal safety standards. Young children may be able to operate these lighters, which could pose a fire hazard. Units: About 1,800.

title: CPSC, PM International Ltd. Announce Recall to Replace International Adapter Plugs
summary: The adapter plug can separate when the plug is removed, exposing live electrical conductors, posing an electric shock or electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,000.

title: CPSC, Whirlpool Announce Recall of Washer and Gas Dryer Units
summary: The gas dryer can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 17,000.

title: Bath & Body Works Recall of Ice Shaver
summary: The stainless steel blade on the shaver can cut consumers and cause injury. Units: About 1,000.

title: CPSC, Holophane Announce Recall of Luminaire Optical Assemblies
summary: The glass portion of the luminaire optical assembly may crack, presenting a laceration hazard. Units: About 1,500.

title: CPSC, BRIO® Corporation and Small World Toys Announce Recall of Snail Pull Toy
summary: The eyes on the pull toy can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 3,000.

title: CPSC, Lauri® Inc. Announce Recall of Toddler Activity Sets and Puzzles
summary: The dog puzzle included with both of these products and the rubber handle on the box of the activity set can tear apart into small pieces and pose a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 110,000 "Toddler Tote™" toddler activity sets, and about 11,000 "Familiar Things" toddler puzzles.

title: CPSC, Radio Flyer Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Steering Wheel on Toy Car
summary: A child can pull the horn from the steering wheel, and a small part inside poses a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 59,080.

title: CPSC, Small World Toys Announce Recall of Sorter Toys
summary: The plastic windows on the "see-inside" sorting blocks can break, causing the beads inside to be released. This presents a choking hazard to children. Units: About 880.

title: CPSC, Cane Creek Announce Recall of Bicycle Suspension Seat Posts
summary: The seat post's cradle, which attaches to the bicycle seat, can break, posing the risk of falls and serious injury to riders. Units: About 7,700.

title: CPSC, Yamaha Motor Corp. U.S.A. Announce Recall to Inspect and Repair ATVs
summary: A mounting-bracket weld on the rear hub can come loose, resulting in rear brake failure and possible injury to operators. Units: About 14,000.

title: CPSC, Young's J.K. Inc. Announce Recall of Novelty Lighters
summary: These lighters do not have child-resistant mechanisms, as required by federal law. Young children could ignite the lighters, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 1,800.

title: CPSC, Flat Rock Grill Co. Announce Recall of Gas Grills
summary: The glass casing of the thermometer displays attached to these grills can break or shatter, posing a risk of cuts or other serious injuries to consumers. Units: About 1,800.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Announce Recall of Red Devil Gas Grills Sold at Wal-Mart
summary: The product's design allows consumers to light the grill at an air intake tube, instead of at the burner. Though the grill appears to function normally, gas inside the air intake tube ignites. The tube can reach temperatures of up to 750 degrees Fahrenheit and present a burn hazard to consumers. In

title: CPSC, Aroma Housewares Co. Announce Another Recall of Juicers
summary: The juicer's filter and lid can break apart and project metal and plastic into the air, causing injuries to consumers. Units: About 117,000.

title: CPSC, Hilton Hotels Corporation Announce Recall of Vacation Station™ Children's Cooler/Chairs
summary: When the chair collapses, the folding mechanism can pose a crushing, cutting or severing hazard to consumers' fingers. Units: About 27,000.

title: CPSC, Jakks Pacific Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Certain Cans of "Smatter" Spray Foam
summary: If the pressurized can is left in a hot automobile, it can forcefully break apart and cause injury to a nearby consumer. Units: Approximately 296,000.

title: CPSC, Johnson Outdoors Inc. Announce Recall of SCUBAPRO/UWATEC™ Dive Computer Consoles
summary: The U-Line™ submersible pressure gauge that is part of the dive consoles can malfunction and display inaccurate pressure readings. Divers using the consoles could fail to decompress properly during a dive, causing decompression sickness. Units: About 1,700.

title: CPSC and Royal Outdoor Products Announce Recall of Colonial Vinyl Deck Post Kits
summary: Cracks can develop near the base of the posts. This can allow the railing to collapse, potentially injuring people on the deck. Units: About 1,250.

title: CPSC, The Coleman Company Announce Recall of Mosquito Traps
summary: The mosquito trap's propane regulator can leak propane or allow an overflow of propane gas, both of which pose a fire hazard to consumers. In addition, the fuel hose attachment sold with the Back Home™ System can become damaged and leak propane, which poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1

title: CPSC, Remington Products Co., LLC Re-Announce Recall of Hairdryers Firm Offering Free Upgraded Replacement Hairdryer
summary: These hairdryers are not equipped with an appliance leakage current interrupter (ALCI) plug to cut off electrical current in case of contact with water. If dropped in water, the hairdryers pose an electrocution hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: CPSC, STK International Announce Recall of Extension Cords
summary: The cords have undersized wires, presenting a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 190,000.
